biography: Vitor Baptista's racing journey began not on a track, but on the dusty, makeshift karting circuits carved into the outskirts of São Paulo. His father, a mechanic with a passion for speed, recognized Vitor's natural talent early, sacrificing his own aspirations to nurture his son's. A defining moment came at the age of 16, during a regional karting championship. Trailing the leader by a seemingly insurmountable margin, Vitor executed a daring last-corner overtake, a move so audacious it became legendary in local racing circles. This victory paved the way for a scholarship to a European racing academy, where he honed his skills in Formula racing before transitioning to GT cars. Now, at the peak of his career, Vitor is a highly respected driver, known for his calculated approach and unwavering focus, currently contracted with KTF Sports, aiming for endurance racing glory.
drivingStyle: Baptista is a master of calculated aggression. He meticulously studies every corner, optimizing his braking points and apex speeds with almost surgical precision. Rather than relying on raw speed, he conserves his tires and fuel, patiently waiting for the opportune moment to strike. He excels under pressure, rarely making mistakes even when challenged by aggressive rivals. His ability to anticipate and react to changing track conditions makes him a formidable opponent in any weather.

rivalries.reason: A long-standing feud stemming from a controversial collision during a GT championship race in 2021. Bellini accused Baptista of intentionally wrecking him, fueling a bitter rivalry that continues to this day.

Dubois and Baptista have clashed several times on track, often battling for the same position. Their rivalry is more respectful, born from intense competition rather than personal animosity, but is just as fierce.

Tanaka's aggressive, late-braking style often puts him at odds with Baptista's calculated approach. Baptista views Tanaka as reckless, while Tanaka sees Baptista as overly cautious, creating a clashing dynamic on the track.

quirks: Always wears the same worn-out pair of driving gloves, claiming they bring him good luck.
Listens to a specific Brazilian samba song on repeat before every race to calm his nerves.
Refuses to eat anything yellow on race days, believing it's bad luck.
famousQuote: "Racing isn't about pushing to the limit every second; it's about knowing precisely where that limit is and exploiting it with intelligence."
careerHighlight: Winning the 24 Hours of Le Mans in 2027 with Power On Racing. Baptista drove a masterful final stint, holding off intense pressure from rivals to secure the victory.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead in the final lap of the Spa 24 Hours in 2025. A mechanical failure caused him to lose control, costing his team a guaranteed win.
